units.title: Position, displacement and velocity
units.text: Position x on an axis. Displacement is the change in position. Average velocity is displacement divided by elapsed time: v_avg = Δx / Δt.
units.queryText: position displacement average velocity Δx / Δt

units.title: Notation: s, u, v, a, t
units.text: We write displacement as s, initial velocity as u, final velocity as v. Initial velocity is written u, final velocity v. Acceleration is a and time is t.
units.queryText: notation displacement s initial velocity u final velocity v acceleration a time t

units.title: Acceleration
units.text: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity, a = dv/dt. It is a vector, so its sign matters.
units.queryText: acceleration rate of change of velocity dv/dt vector

units.title: Equations of motion
units.text: For constant acceleration: v = u + a t. Also s = u t + a t². And v² = u² + 2 a s.
units.queryText: equations of motion constant acceleration v = u + a t s = u t + a t^2

units.title: Free fall
units.text: Free fall: take downward as positive, so a = +g = +9.8 m/s². A dropped stone speeds up: v = g t.
units.queryText: free fall downward positive a = +g 9.8 m/s^2 dropped stone

units.title: Newton's first law
units.text: Newton's first law: an object keeps its state of rest or uniform motion unless a net external force acts on it. Inertial frames.
units.queryText: newton first law inertia net external force inertial frame

units.title: Newton's second law
units.text: Newton's second law: F = m a. The net force equals mass times acceleration. In general F = dp/dt where p = m v.
units.queryText: newton second law F = m a net force mass acceleration momentum dp/dt

units.title: Friction
units.text: Friction: f = μ N. Friction always equals μ N, whether or not the object is sliding.
units.queryText: friction f = μ N coefficient of friction normal force sliding

units.title: Velocity is the slope of the x-t graph
units.text: Velocity = slope of the x-t graph. Steeper means faster. Average velocity = Δx / Δt.

lines.text: Velocity = slope of the x-t graph

units.title: Trick: area under the v-t graph
units.text: Trick: the area under a v-t graph is the displacement. Count squares on the grid for non-uniform motion.

units.title: Newton 2: lift example
units.text: Lift accelerating up: T - m g = m a, so T = m (g + a). Net force F = m a again.
